artifact.en: The message, call, letter or notice the user is asking about, as the user shared it.

link_check.en: Simulated link-reputation result for a link the user shared.

call_warning.en: Simulated network call warning that was shown to the user during the call.

user_call_notes.en: Notes the user typed about a call. No recordings exist.

subscription.products.en: The identified customer's subscriptions (operator's own service context).

subscription.recent_events.en: Recent SIM/eSIM, porting, order and billing events on the subscription, with the channel and how the requester was authenticated (the operator knows how a request was authenticated, not whether the real customer made it).

subscription.network_status.en: Whether the user's line currently has network service.

device.summary.en: Platform, OS version and patch status of the device the user is chatting from.

device.recent_app_installs.en: Apps installed in the last 14 days, with source and granted permissions. Assumes an optional operator security app on Android or Windows; null on iOS, where apps cannot inspect other apps.

device.security_findings.en: Findings from the same optional security app (remote-access apps, accessibility services). Null on iOS.

operator_account.recent_logins.en: Recent logins to the user's operator account (time, country, known device).

credential_exposure.en: Result of an optional breach-monitoring check for the user's email address.

business.profile.en: Company size, roles and admin set-up as known to the operator's business service.

business.staff_accounts.en: Business user list with last activity, for small-business admins only.
